description: perf/native-core, 2026-10-17, M2 Max. docker: Linux aarch64 VM of Docker Desktop (12 CPUs, 16 GB), PyFE4AI in a throwaway container of the unchanged pyfe4ai-pairing image (Python 3.10.22, GCC 13.3) with a rustup minimal stable toolchain (rustc 1.99.1, LLVM 23.1.1, aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu) added for this run; crates from the host cache, built offline. TenSEAL 0.3.18 in pyfe4ai-he (Python 3.11.17, whitepaper/scripts/he_baseline.py). host: macOS, Python 3.13, rustc on the host.

commits.8f09fc9: Rust backend, OS bytes for the samples (before the DRBG)
commits.a722be3: DRBG + Rust string output + BLS12-381 pairings
commits.eb9cc29: a722be3 + Rust integer / binary-ciphertext reading fixes
